Starship tower-catch cassette skin for Wampy, v1.0.

**Download `starship-wampy-all-v9.zip` below.** Unzip it at the top level of the Walkman's internal storage, restart the player, then set Tape = `starship` and Reel = `starship` in Wampy → Settings → Skin → Cassette. The matching Winamp skin `Starship.wsz` is included.

Contents: the cassette tape (ETC1 + JPEG fallback), an animated reel (114 frames, ETC1 atlas + JPEG fallback, 180 ms per frame) and the Winamp skin. Nothing else is in the zip.

Not yet tested on hardware. Fan-made tribute; not affiliated with or endorsed by SpaceX.
